summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Polki manufacturing tracker. Backend: 33 pytest cases (auth/JWT/lockout-format/permissions, karigars w/ process filter, kapan CRUD + cascade delete, full 6-stage process chain with derived calcs, entries filters, jangad payload, dashboard/meta) - 32 passed, 1 failed (missing /api/auth/refresh). Frontend: admin login, dashboard, karigar create w/ multi-process, kapan create (auto kapan_no = weight, auto size 25.05), issue Laser from kapan detail with process-filtered karigar dropdown, receive with live Loss/Loss%/Return%, complete chain shape->polish->table polish->nats->filling (Weight Gain shown for filling), Packet Issue full column set, Packet Receive shows only open packets (0 after chain), Jangad print slip + Print button, staff creation with granular permissions, staff RBAC (no Staff nav, no delete buttons, can create kapan/issue), staff disable blocks login with 'Account is disabled', mobile 390px hamburger + horizontally scrollable tables + usable dialogs. Two functional defects found (reconciliation Polish Weight and D/S leakage).

critical.issue: polish_weight uses max(return_weight) across polish/table_polish/nats/filling instead of the FINAL returned stage weight. A perfectly balanced chain (250.50 -> laser 200/boil5/rc10 -> shape 180/boil2/nail3 -> polish 170 -> table 165 -> nats 163 -> filling 165) reports polish_weight 170.00, accounted 255.50 and difference -5.00 with balanced=false. Using the last-stage return weight (165) gives accounted exactly 250.50. UI therefore shows 'UNACCOUNTED -5.00 CT' on a correct kapan.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but not implemented (refresh_token cookie is issued but unusable).
Accepts ds/hw/expected_return_pcs for processes where they are not applicable (no server-side field-set validation), so bogus 'D/S: Single/Double' is stored for shape/table_polish/nats/filling.
No validation that issued weight/pcs <= kapan remaining weight, and no check that a stage is issued only once while open; over-issuing is silently accepted.

ui_bugs.issue: form.ds (default 'Single') is always sent in the POST body regardless of PROCESS_CONFIG, so the H/W · D/S column on Kapan detail / Packet Issue and the Jangad slip show a meaningless 'Single'/'Double' for Shape Cutting, Table Polish, Nats and Filling. Send ds/hw/expected_return_pcs only when cfg.issue contains that field.
Filling rows show Loss 0.00 / Loss % 0.00 with no Weight Gain column; the 2.00 ct gain is only visible in the live receive dialog and in the balance bar. Add a Gain column/row for filling.

integration_issues.issue: Balance bar shows 'UNACCOUNTED -5.00 CT' (red) and the Kapan register Diff column shows -5.00 for an arithmetically correct process chain - direct consequence of the backend polish_weight max() bug.

issues: Date fields use the native browser date picker (<input type=date>) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component, inconsistent with the design guidelines
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on every dialog - add DialogDescription for a11y

action_items: Fix build_report(): polish_weight must be the return_weight of the LAST returned stage (max stage_order), not max() of return weights, so balanced chains reconcile to difference 0.00
Implement POST /api/auth/refresh (or remove it from test_credentials.md)
IssueDialog: only send hw / ds / expected_return_pcs for processes whose PROCESS_CONFIG.issue includes them; also strip/ignore them server-side
Show Weight Gain for filling entries in the kapan detail table, Packet Issue table and Jangad slip
Consider validating issued weight against kapan remaining weight on POST /api/entries
Add DialogDescription to dialogs to clear the a11y console warning
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_report(): the `polish_weight = max(...)` heuristic is the single source of the reconciliation mismatch; last_returned is already computed by stage_order but unused for polish_weight
server.py receive_entry()/update_entry(): the whole document (including _id popped) is re-$set on every receive - fine functionally but consider $set of computed fields only
No server-side per-process field whitelist; EntryCreate accepts all extra fields for every process
core.py login lockout is per ip:email and never cleaned up by TTL index - add a TTL index on login_attempts.last_attempt

TestKapanChain::test_polish_table_nats_filling encodes the current (buggy) accounted_weight 255.50 / difference -5.00 expectation - after the polish_weight fix, update those two asserts to 250.50 / 0.00 and expect balanced=true. test_refresh_endpoint_exists is the only known failure. rca_of_the_issue: build_report() computes polish_weight as max(return_weight) over {polish, table_polish, nats, filling} returned entries. Since weight decreases down the chain (polish 170 -> table 165 -> nats 163), max() returns the earliest stage weight (170) instead of the final on-hand weight (165), inflating accounted_weight by 5.00 and marking the kapan unbalanced. Fix: pick the return_weight of the entry with the highest PROCESSES stage_order among returned entries (last_returned already tracks this).
